result.instructions: This gateway controls one configured T3 Code environment for an orchestrator outside T3. T3 remains authoritative for projects, threads, messages, runs, and workspaces. Native T3 tools (t3_project_*, t3_thread_*, t3_queue_*, schedules, pull requests, orchestrator_capabilities) are forwarded unchanged. As an outside client, pass projectId or threadId explicitly. Use t3_threads_list and t3_threads_overview to see what needs attention across projects. By default they show the open queue: open threads that are not working, without subagent children. To supervise working threads, pass status=all or onlyRunning=true to t3_threads_list, or read a known thread with t3_thread_read (view=activity for tool calls) and t3_thread_wait. Use t3_thread_send with mode=steer, queue, or restart to redirect running work. Prefer t3_task_start for delegated work: it is retry-safe with an idempotencyKey, can prepare a worktree, and pairs with t3_task_get, t3_result_get, and t3_task_cancel. Monitor it with t3_thread_wait using the task's threadId. Answer approvals with t3_pending_action_respond; native tools cannot. Interrupts are requests: confirm them with t3_thread_read or t3_thread_wait. Usage is recorded in a local redacted audit trail; use t3_audit_log to inspect tool calls, upstream requests, Git commands, outcomes, and timings.

setup.gatewayService:
[Unit]
Description=T3 Code MCP gateway
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=1min
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=<SETUP_ROOT>
EnvironmentFile=<SETUP_ROOT>/config/t3-code-mcp.env
ExecStart=/usr/bin/node <SETUP_ROOT>/dist/cli.js serve
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s
TimeoutStopSec=10s
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=full
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
NoNewPrivileges=yes
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

Requires=t3-code-mcp.service
Wants=network-online.target
After=t3-code-mcp.service network-online.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=1min
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=<SETUP_ROOT>
EnvironmentFile=<SETUP_ROOT>/config/t3-code-mcp.env
ExecStart=<SETUP_ROOT>/deploy/systemd/t3-code-mcp-tunnel.sh
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10s
TimeoutStopSec=20s
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=full
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
NoNewPrivileges=yes
UMask=0077

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
setup.tunnelLauncher:
#!/bin/sh

set -eu

: "${MCP_BEARER_TOKEN:?MCP_BEARER_TOKEN must be set}"
: "${CONTROL_PLANE_API_KEY:?CONTROL_PLANE_API_KEY must be set}"

# tunnel-client resolves an entire header value from an env: reference. Build
# the scheme-qualified value at launch so it stays synchronized with the
# gateway token without putting the token in ExecStart or a second secret file.
MCP_AUTH_HEADER="Bearer ${MCP_BEARER_TOKEN}"
export MCP_AUTH_HEADER

attempt=0
while [ "$attempt" -lt 60 ]; do
  if /usr/bin/curl --silent --fail --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8787/healthz >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    break
  fi
  attempt=$((attempt + 1))
  /usr/bin/sleep 1
done
if [ "$attempt" -ge 60 ]; then
  echo "gateway health check did not become ready" >&2
  exit 1
fi

exec /usr/local/bin/tunnel-client run \
  --control-plane.tunnel-id=tunnel-baseline \
  --control-plane.api-key=env:CONTROL_PLANE_API_KEY \
  --mcp.server-url=url=http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp,channel=main \
  '--mcp.extra-headers=Authorization: env:MCP_AUTH_HEADER' \
  '--mcp.discovery-extra-headers=Authorization: env:MCP_AUTH_HEADER' \
  --health.listen-addr=127.0.0.1:8080
setup.environment:
# Generated by `node dist/cli.js setup`. Keep credentials server-side with mode 600.
# Never commit this file or paste tokens into voice prompts.

T3_HTTP_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3773
T3_ENVIRONMENT_ID=environment-baseline
T3_ENVIRONMENT_LABEL=coding
T3_ACCESS_TOKEN=

# A separate, randomly generated gateway token. Do not reuse T3_ACCESS_TOKEN.
MCP_BEARER_TOKEN=

# Start read-only for the first connection check; false enables control tools.
MCP_READ_ONLY=true
MCP_TRANSPORT=http
MCP_HOST=127.0.0.1
MCP_PORT=8787
# This directory also receives audit.jsonl, the append-only redacted usage trail,
# and native-mcp-credential.json from `node dist/cli.js native-login`.
T3_MCP_DATA_DIR=<SETUP_ROOT>/data
# Optional absolute root for gateway-created isolated Git worktrees.
T3_MCP_WORKTREE_ROOT=

# OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel runtime key. This is not an admin key.
CONTROL_PLANE_API_KEY=

setup.stderr: Setup rendered without secrets. Edit the env file to set T3_ACCESS_TOKEN, MCP_BEARER_TOKEN, and CONTROL_PLANE_API_KEY (mode 600), then enable the user services.
